name: nlp_instruction_sft
title: Instruction tuning with TRL's SFTTrainer over a 4-bit quantised base and a LoRA adapter, packed chat-template text and a token-accuracy metric
origin: hardening round 2, domain-nlp, 2026-09-14 - the 2025/26 LLM post-training stack (trl + peft + bitsandbytes), which no corpus program covered
note: Zero findings in both dataflow modes on 2026-09-14, which is the right answer - this program is correct. What it measures is coverage rather than precision: MLView has no knowledge table for trl or peft and says so in two unresolved_callee diagnostics, and the consequence is that the objective, train, eval and deliver stages are all declared ABSENT on a complete fine-tuning script. The declaration is honest; the blind spot is real and is recorded as NLP2-11.

forbidden.why: transformers.set_seed(SEED) is the first statement of main() (line 88) and SFTConfig carries seed= and data_seed= (lines 83-84)
the dataset arrives already split into train and test (line 11); the only shuffle passes seed=SEED (line 34)
the SFTTrainer is given eval_dataset= and compute_metrics= (lines 97-99) and SFTConfig sets eval_strategy="epoch" (line 76)
compute_metrics takes np.argmax(logits[:, :-1, :], axis=-1) on line 54 before the comparison
there is no hand-written evaluation loop; the SFTTrainer owns the eval pass
the same - no torch loop exists in this workspace
there is no hand-written training step - trainer.train() owns zero_grad, backward and step
the same - no backward() appears anywhere
no DataLoader is constructed here; the Trainer builds its own
the same, and main() is reachable only from the __main__ guard (line 109)
device_map="auto" (line 42) is accelerate's placement and the Trainer moves the batches; nothing is moved by hand
no .cuda() and no torch.device literal appears anywhere; torch.bfloat16 is a dtype
no nn.Module subclass is defined in this workspace
the adapter is written with trainer.save_model / tokenizer.save_pretrained (lines 104-105); torch.save and torch.load do not appear
nothing is fitted - the chat template is applied, and the tokenizer comes from a pretrained checkpoint
the same, and the eval rows are only rendered, never fitted on
there is no Keras code in this project

unsupported.defect: none - use_cache is disabled before the wrap and print_trainable_parameters confirms the adapter attached
unsupported.why: MLView has no knowledge table for peft, so neither this nor its failure modes (an adapter applied to a model that was already wrapped, target_modules that match nothing) can be scored

unsupported.defect: none - the SFTTrainer is a transformers.Trainer subclass and is configured with an eval dataset, a metric and an evaluation strategy
unsupported.why: MLView has no knowledge table for trl, so MLV708 cannot judge an SFTTrainer / DPOTrainer / GRPOTrainer at all, in either direction

unsupported.defect: none - nf4 with double quantisation and a bfloat16 compute dtype is the documented QLoRA configuration

The observation is kept verbatim here so the row can be restored the day the rule ships.
